source_findings.path: HC unit3 Work at lines 24-27 and HyperConnection::pre from line 48
source_findings.fact: Allocated scratch tensors are retained by Work; its destructor synchronizes the stream. The T1 BF16 branch allocates separate collapsed/post/comb/hit outputs, poisons output storage, zeroes hit, launches the epilogue on the Runtime stream, runs existing Sinkhorn, synchronizes, and returns shared output tensors. Constructor parameter copies also synchronize before stack constants expire.
source_findings.exclusion: No obvious source-level temporary lifetime expiry or deliberately aliased input/output buffer was found in this branch.
source_findings.limit: Separate allocation requests are not an independent proof of the runtime allocator's physical non-overlap or absence of corruption elsewhere. No failing-request tensor dump exists to prove intermediate values.

source_findings.fact: The first four lanes initialize all four shared pre values and all four post values; they write disjoint four-element comb rows. A block-wide barrier precedes collapsed reads. A 256-thread stride covers all 4096 collapsed elements. The inspected kernel has no persistent model-data storage.
source_findings.exclusion: No missing shared initialization, missing pre-read barrier, or uncovered output element was found for the fixed launch geometry.
source_findings.limit: The fused sigmoid/softmax/collapse uses its declared floating-point evaluation and BF16 rounding. Existing tolerant oracle qualification does not make it bit-identical to the original SDK path, and this audit cannot identify those numerical differences as the cause of the final answer error.

source_findings.fact: The loaded-engine reset validates cache geometry/rank, synchronizes, trims memory, and dispatches model reset. NativeDecoderR20::reset at line 65 of SHA 1886f34a86308859e521778326e3e1119d93ff8e4d85e1ff1f2a3af3b3d6dfa9 resets the selected attention/cache implementation, clears decoder lengths, and clears poisoned_.
source_findings.limit: API reset success does not prove every internal valid cache value or every downstream implementation was independently compared between the six requests.

source_findings.fact: Reset invokes cache reset, explicitly zeroes compressor state bytes, synchronizes, clears lengths, and increments revision.
source_findings.limit: Raw cache allocation bytes need not all be zero when validity metadata controls reads. Reset not clearing all raw allocation bytes is not evidence of an uninitialized read. This bounded source audit did not prove all reset consumers read only valid prefixes.

source_findings.path: deep_owner_events_r8900.hpp; owner arm/read wrappers in deep_model_owner_r8900.cpp
source_findings.fact: The inspected owner observer stores event handles, timing/seen/done metadata and Runtime/decoder/stream identities. Context restores its previous thread-local active pointer on destruction. Arm/read do not directly assign model tensors, weights, cache payloads, or HC mode. Read clears the owner window after validating completed rows.
source_findings.limit: GPU event operations, synchronization timing, and DeviceGuard changes are executable side effects; absence of direct tensor writes is not proof of bitwise numerical transparency or exclusion of timing-sensitive faults in another component.

source_findings.path: deep_attention_inner_r9193.hpp, with the identity limit above
source_findings.fact: The inspected inner observer records seven events per Frame, host timings and pointer identities; finish validates event timing and destruction. Arm/read manage host row state and reject in-flight windows. No direct mathematical tensor assignment was found in those routines.
source_findings.limit: Do not promote this source inspection to a new GPU qualification or claim it proves lack of all cross-request side effects.

concrete_failure_path_contract_caveat_no.native_owner_behavior: Owner arm rejects any call while window is nonzero before testing w==0. Therefore arm(0) does not abort an already armed owner window.
concrete_failure_path_contract_caveat_no.wrapper_behavior: After an arm/read exception the wrapper attempts both arm(0) calls, records whether they succeeded, raises OwnerWindowStillArmed if not, and never issues a subsequent forward on that failed path.
concrete_failure_path_contract_caveat_no.qualification: Fake cleanup leaves accepting arm(0) unconditionally do not establish real Native abort semantics. This is a failure-cleanup contract limitation, not a proven mathematical defect.
concrete_failure_path_contract_caveat_no.393_relevance: All four original captures returned valid completed rows and closed windows. No such observer arm/read exception was observed before the final answer failure. This caveat does not explain the quality failure and does not justify a new run or hot fix.

facts: All six had 8489 prompt tokens, the same semantic input, 98 Native calls including EOS, successful before/after reset calls, and recorded HC mode1 completions of 86 modules per owner per forward.
Only requests 3 and 4 armed observers, at decode calls 8 and 87. All four original captures had 344 completed owner rows and 344 completed inner rows and closed windows.

Requests 0 through 4 passed the task. Request 5 failed: right.sum and total were each +1; left.sum, nonces and tool selection/mapping were unchanged. Its first output token-ID divergence was index 83.
The final OFF position in the schedule does not identify a cause or exclude a persistent side effect of previous requests.
No per-layer hidden values, logits, margin, or failing-request cache-state snapshot was saved at the first divergence. The earliest internal divergence and its cause remain UNKNOWN.
Finally engine shutdown completed and post checks were clean, but normal_Native_shutdown remained false after the quality exception. Full normal-success lifecycle is not retroactively claimed.
